jobs.description_text: About the Role The Core Licensing & Devices team owns the layer that turns Verkada's licenses into revenue: a double-entry accounting ledger that reconciles every license into daily revenue recognition. This is the system Finance closes the books on and the one auditors trace, so every entry has to be right. As Verkada scales past millions of devices and the business matures toward tighter reporting and audit requirements, this system moves from important to load-bearing. We're a small, high-trust, high-autonomy team. We give and receive feedback directly, we learn out loud, and we hold a high bar on both execution and written communication. What You'll Do Own the double-entry accounting ledger that reconciles licensing into daily revenue recognition — its accounting model, its invariants, and its correctness guarantees under concurrency, retries, and failure. Design and lead the systems behind upmarket licensing: pay-as-you-go metering and billing, fixed-term commitments, and the packaging our enterprise customers buy. Build reconciliation and controls that let Finance close the books daily and let auditors trace any recognized dollar back to its source — with the auditability, immutability, and lineage a maturing company requires. Partner with Finance, Accounting, Revenue, and Product to turn revenue-recognition policy (ASC 606, deferred revenue, contract modifications, true-ups) into precise, testable system behavior. jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer - Operations
jobs.description_text: At Acron, our ambition is to relentlessly reimagine and reshape the value chains through which we deliver results to our customers, suppliers, and stakeholder communities, all in pursuit of innovations that create safer skies. Across the Avionics Business Unit, our employees strive to achieve world-class results by putting customers first, owning outcomes, moving fast, and speaking candidly. We are seeking a Senior Electrical Engineer to join the Recorders Zero Defect team at our Grand Rapids, Michigan facility. This engineer will be the team’s electrical design subject matter expert, working alongside Product Quality, Manufacturing, and Test Engineering to identify and permanently resolve defects across the production lifecycle, including supplier, factory, integration, calibration, and test-related issues. The role is centered on electrical design defect resolution. You will apply hands-on electronics and Circuit Card Assembly (CCA) expertise to determine whether recurring defects are driven by schematic design, component selection, circuit behavior, PCB layout, design margin, environmental sensitivity, manufacturability, or testability. You will collaborate with Design Engineering and Operations to validate root causes, implement corrective actions, and strengthen product robustness, yield, quality, and cost performance.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Systems Engineering
jobs.description_text: As Senior Systems Engineering Manager for avionics, you will lead the organization responsible for translating customer and business needs into safe, certifiable, and supportable aircraft systems. You will guide systems architecture, requirements, interfaces, safety, integration, verification, and certification across the product lifecycle for commercial, military, rotorcraft, and emerging air mobility platforms. You will shape systems engineering strategy, workforce capability, processes, tools, and execution priorities. Working across hardware, software, program management, product management, quality, manufacturing, airworthiness, customers, and regulatory authorities, you will ensure technical integrity while delivering to cost, schedule, quality, and performance commitments.

jobs.title: Sr. Specialist, Systems Engineer (Environmental Qualification)
jobs.description_text: Acron Aviation is seeking a Senior Specialist, Systems Engineer for our Environmental Qualifications to provide technical leadership for the planning, coordination, execution, and closure of environmental qualification activities for airborne surveillance and avionics products. This senior individual contributor will own qualification strategy and execution across assigned programs, ensuring product requirements, certification objectives, test configurations, laboratory activities, and compliance evidence are complete, traceable, and technically defensible. The successful candidate will combine systems-level judgment with practical qualification-test experience. The role requires close coordination with systems, hardware, software, mechanical, certification, quality, program management, suppliers, customers, and internal or external test laboratories. The engineer will lead test readiness, resolve qualification issues, communicate risks clearly, and drive activities through final reporting and closure.

jobs.title: Sr. Specialist, Systems Engineer (Test Equip)
jobs.description_text: Acron Aviation is seeking a Senior Specialist, Systems Engineer (Test Equip) to lead the design, development, integration, update, maintenance, and operational support of engineering test equipment used for airborne surveillance and avionics products. This senior individual contributor will translate product and verification requirements into reliable, maintainable, and well-documented test solutions that support development, integration, qualification, regression, production-support, and troubleshooting activities. The successful candidate will combine systems-level understanding with hands-on electrical, software, instrumentation, and laboratory experience. The role requires ownership across the full test equipment lifecycle, from requirements and architecture through design, checkout, release, configuration control, upgrades, calibration, troubleshooting, obsolescence management, and user support.

jobs.description_text: At Acron our ambition is to relentlessly reimagine and reshape the value chains by which we deliver results to our customers, suppliers, and internal/external stakeholder communities in pursuit of innovations to creating safer skies. The Working Team Lead is a front-line leadership role responsible for supporting daily operations, team performance, schedule execution, and issue escalation within the value stream. The Working Lead serves as the primary liaison between operations employees and the Value Stream Leader (VSL), ensuring that the daily operations plan is executed safely, efficiently, and in compliance with established standards.

jobs.title: Fiber Engineer
jobs.description_text: FIBER ENGINEER As a Fiber Engineer at SpaceX, you will work in a complex environment designing and supporting a variety of critical infrastructure. The IT Network Infrastructure Engineering team designs and builds critical infrastructure that supports the functionality, growth, and reliability of AI training and inference for our mission to understand the universe and make life multiplanetary. The team plans, designs, and constructs new data centers, capacity expansions, and technology refreshes in existing regions, and manages operation of the existing fleet to ensure system reliability and efficiency. The team includes electrical, mechanical, and telecommunications engineers with cross-disciplinary experience. We strive for timely delivery of efficient data centers that support the latest technologies and hardware architectures while maintaining uptime. As a IT Network Infrastructure Engineer focused on Data Centers, you will design large cable plants and low-voltage systems for the latest network architectures at scale. You will ensure scalability while future-proofing data center cabling plants for changes in network architectures and data transmission speeds beyond 800G. You will work collaboratively and cross-functionally with capacity planning, network engineering, hardware reliability, construction, and operations. jobs.title: Fluid Systems Engineer, Production (Starship)
jobs.description_text: FLUIDS ENGINEER, PRODUCTION (STARSHIP) Starship is the largest and most capable space launch system ever developed. With the capability to deliver in excess of 100 metric tons to Earth’s orbit, it will fundamentally change access to space, and is the technology that will be used to establish a self-sustaining city on Mars. We will ultimately need thousands of Starships to accomplish that feat. The Starbase production fluids team builds, maintains, and operates the fluid systems the Starship factory runs on. This includes high pressure production test equipment used to validate vehicles and components, vehicle press systems, and cleaning and contamination control equipment. Engineers on this team own hardware from problem statement through design, build, commissioning, and handoff to the technicians and operators who use it every day. We are looking for hands-on engineers who can reduce a messy production problem to first principles, design the simplest system that meets the requirement, and stay with it until it is fully handed off and documented. You will work directly with our build shop, partner teams, and production customers on an accelerated schedule. RESPONSIBILITIES: Design, build, and commission fluid systems for Starship production, including test systems, manufacturing systems, and cleaning equipment. jobs.description_text: FLUID SYSTEMS ENGINEER, STARLINK INFRASTRUCTURE The Starlink Infrastructure team is building world-class production facilities in Bastrop, Texas to support vertically integrated manufacturing of solar cells, user terminals, and PCBAs, along with terrestrial and in-space SI data centers. The specialty fluid systems behind these factories are the backbone of production, and this team owns them end to end: chemical and specialty gas delivery, cryogenic storage and distribution, zero-liquid discharge wastewater processing, Air-separation units, and freshwater intake and treatment. As a Fluid Systems Engineer, you will lead the design, build, and commissioning of these systems. You will be the extreme owner for your systems, carrying novel designs from first requirement through activation and sustained operation. The problems are real and the scale is large: high-volume chip fabrication, solar production, SI compute, and a rapidly expanding constellation of Starlink satellites all depend on the infrastructure this team delivers. This is the future of American manufacturing, built from the ground up. Aerospace experience is not required to be successful here - we want our engineers to bring fresh ideas from all areas, love solving problems, and seek to make an impact on an inspiring mission.
